fact: The Caisse de Sécurité Sociale announced on 2 September 2026 that social benefits will be paid into beneficiaries' Wave accounts, with enrolment by form and no start date given.

The Treasury directorate (DGCPT) launched SenTrésor on 2 June 2025, a digital platform to pay state expenditure including salaries, allowances, pensions, scholarships and social aid, with instant receipt of payment.
The DGCPT says SenTrésor pays salaries and allowances, pensions, scholarships and social aid, and names village chiefs, students and salaried staff as beneficiaries.
The state has chosen Orange Money as the distribution channel for certain public credit programmes, directing aid flows through it, according to economist Seydou Bocoum.
